title: Certify exact functional-1 owned-kernel invoice floor by weak duality
body:
## Result

PR5144 left an exact weak-duality question after its functional-1 numerical solve returned zero. This contribution certifies that every one of the retained model's 2^9188 binary contact assignments has nonnegative complete paid-minus-helper invoice delta at C=.00302177585. The unchanged source attains zero. No kappa or universal barrier is claimed.

The source-derived doubled graph includes all14,480 pair terms,408 productive helpers,eight full owned COPY charges,72 shared late native maps and12 prelude constraints. A saved flow on61,138 directed arcs satisfies exact conservation and saturates the explicit unchanged-source cut. Normal verification reconstructs the pinned source graph and checks the witness independently of the optimizer. Integer coefficient vectors and rigorous rational logarithm/exponential enclosures establish every real inequality; floating solver output is not part of acceptance.

## Validation and scope

Normal and optimized standard-library replay pass, including18 complete source-invoice/cut calibrations and actual capacity, conservation, missing-arc and typed-flow corruption controls. Source-history and official15-file export checks pass. Fresh Git-free normal/optimized replay and optimized missing-SOURCES, missing-RESULT, altered-source-byte and integer-to-float receipt controls pass. The package contains the full proof, source pins, typed receipt and explicit regeneration command. Independent peer review is recorded separately in the handoff.

This reuses and credits Cinna Davis /1337isnot1337's PR5144 model and its attributed predecessors, unchanged. It closes only that fixed binary functional-1 question at one price. The concurrent five-label/two-axis contact investigation in discussion4611 comment19145731 changes the model and is outside this certificate. No other510 functionals were searched. Actual shared-G synthesis, signed native endpoints, physical compiler, precision and recursive outer admission remain separate unresolved obligations, not zero-cost assumptions. No selected-frontier files changed.
